# Certificate Generator App

This is a JavaScript application for generating certificates from templates (PDF or Figma designs) using data from CSV or XLSX files.

- The app should support uploading and using PDF templates
- It should allow importing data from CSV and XLSX files
- It should generate certificates by merging the template with the data
- It should provide a simple UI for the user to interact with
